v36_checks.note: SEO audit implementation (2026-11-10): T1 canonical on every page, T2 title/description patterns, T3 schema (aggregateRating removed), T4 semantics and accessibility, T5 performance (hero img, map facades, deferred prefill), T6 single-trade hub noindex + San Juan merge with stubs, T7 OG tags, favicons, custom 404, sitemap lastmod.
v36_checks.img_check_scope: generated pages only (written pages + claimed + 404); the copied pilot match-thanks page is excluded
v36_checks.check_adjustments: link check: an href resolving to a real file in the tree (favicon links) counts as resolved, not only directory pages; em dash check skips the binary brand art (.png/.ico), which carries no copy.

accounts_wiring.note: Accounts wiring (Supabase, publishable key in client code): header Sign in + user menu on every page, listing Save buttons backed by saved_pros, YourTownPros reviews fetched client-side (approved only, separate from Google ratings), /claim/ requires sign-in and inserts into claims, /account/ page with profile, claims, saved pros, reviews and change requests. Progressive enhancement: all directory content is static and works with Supabase unreachable.

v37_checks.note: v3.7: Leaflet + OpenStreetMap category maps with numbered pins synced to the result cards under sort and filters, Census batch geocoding with an on-disk cache, left filter rail (rating + enrichment attributes + Has a website; no price filter), county layer with county hubs, IndexNow key emission, sitemap segmented by template. v3.8 supersedes two v3.7 details: every category page now carries a Leaflet map (city-centered when no member is geocoded), and listing pages moved from the facade to native Leaflet as well.

leaflet.note: v3.7 shipped Leaflet on category pages only; v3.8 extends it to listing pages.

v38_checks.note: v3.8: claims verification (slug always written via the resolver/picker, /verify-data.json, per-business methods: email match, website/DNS code, Facebook code, document route; codes shown on /claimed/ and /account/; approval only from the back-office sweep), featured tier mechanics from yourtownpros-featured.json (badge, Sponsored slot, booking block, featured match routing into match_requests + priority FormSubmit subject; instant alerts TO the shop activate when a sending channel exists, today the alert path is Robert's inbox plus the match_requests row), category two-pane layout (BEFORE: filters 236px, results, 340px rail holding the facade or pinned map plus the match form; AFTER: filters 232px, results with the match form below the list, sticky map panel minmax(340px, 42%) at calc(100vh - 96px), stacking map-first at 320px below 1024px), Leaflet on every category page (pins or city-centered zoom 12), pin popup mini-cards, listing pages on native Leaflet (facade retired) with a plain-text Get directions link, and exactly one location line per result card. SCHEMA: apply rankly-plan/yourtownpros-supabase-schema-v2.sql (verify_code, verify_method, approved_via on claims) BEFORE pushing v3.8; the claim insert retries without the verify fields if they are missing.

v39_checks.note: v3.9: owner dashboard at /business/ (noindex, out of sitemap): left nav Overview / Business Information / Reviews / Page Upgrades over a client-side pane. Header account menu gains a Business dashboard entry unhidden only when the profile is_owner probe passes. The dashboard gates on at least one approved claim; signed-in users without one see their claim statuses and the /claim/ route. Overview shows a card per claimed business (approved date from claims.decided_at), a Reminders checklist computed from the owner's real change requests and reviews, the Featured upsell card (no price) and the v4.0 numbers note; NO performance numbers are shown. Business Information renders the listing's current facts from /biz-data.json (same rows and website evidence as the public listing) plus the moderated change-request form (moved from /account/, which now links here) and the owner's submitted requests with statuses. Reviews lists the business's YourTownPros reviews, pending and approved with status labels, and an owner response box on approved reviews; the response update writes ONLY response_text + response_at and the listing renders it under the review, labeled Response from the owner, preferring response_text over the legacy owner_response. SCHEMA: apply rankly-plan/yourtownpros-supabase-schema-v3.sql BEFORE pushing v3.9; every read/write of the new columns retries without them, so the site degrades gracefully if the migration lands late.

schema_v3_flags.reviews_update_policy: row-level: Postgres RLS cannot restrict which columns an UPDATE touches
schema_v3_flags.field_restriction_enforced_by: the dashboard client writing only response_text and response_at
schema_v3_flags.hardening_recommended: BEFORE UPDATE trigger on reviews reverting every column except response_text and response_at for non-service roles

v40_checks.note: v4.0: data plumbing for honest numbers. Optional reviews snapshot (approved YourTownPros reviews only, fetched by yourtownpros-fetch-reviews.py) drives the extractive 'What people say on YourTownPros' block on listings with >= 2 approved text reviews: complete sentences quoted verbatim, chosen by representativeness within the business's own review text, count stated; no paraphrase, no star-derived language. Optional GoatCounter snapshot (real per-hit export via yourtownpros-fetch-gc.py) ships as /gc-snapshot.json and the /business/ Overview numbers card shows a claimed business's real listing/category views with window and counting start labeled; absent a snapshot or an entry, the v3.9 note stays word-for-word. The Bleed Report is a back-office tool (yourtownpros-bleed-report.py) for Robert's one-to-one delivery; both GoatCounter tools refuse to write anything without the API token.

v41_checks.note: v4.1: DevOps + security pass. The only site change is form honeypots: every match form and the claim form carry a hidden company_website field (offscreen, tabindex -1, autocomplete off); a capture-phase guard script on every generated page aborts any submit whose honeypot is filled, before the form's own handler runs, and the claim and featured-match submit handlers check the field again themselves. A filled honeypot is dropped silently: no error, no insert, no email; normal submissions are unchanged. Everything else in this version is back-office: the live RLS audit, schema v4, the secret scan, the backup tool and the incident runbook.

rls_audit.result: see audit doc: full matrix with three self-approval holes found live (claim insert with status approved, review insert with status approved, profile is_owner self-set); all other checks passed; test rows and the test user were deleted and table counts verified back to the pre-audit snapshot

insert throttles: claims 5/day, reviews 10/day, saved_pros 50/day per user

audit fixes: claims and reviews inserts by non-service roles are forced to status pending; claims status/decided_at/approved_via frozen against non-service updates; profiles is_owner frozen against non-service updates

v42_checks.note: v4.2: house claim strips restored (same component, slugged link, sign-in gating; no match form added) + full mobile/tablet pass. Desktop >= 1200px unchanged: all layout rules live in two max-width media blocks appended last (V42_CSS). Category nav decision: at tablet/phone the nav is one scrollable row and its dropdowns become position:fixed panels pinned under the nav row by HEADER_SCRIPT, because a plain overflow-x:auto row clips absolutely positioned dropdowns; dropdowns stay fully usable. Category phone order comes from display:contents on the results column plus explicit order values.

v43_checks.note: v4.3: in-flow document upload for claims. The document method shows a file input in the claim form; on submit the file uploads to the private claim-documents bucket at <user_id>/<slug>-<suffix>.<ext> BEFORE the claim insert, which then carries document_path. If that insert errors (schema v5 not applied yet), it retries without the column and keeps the path in notes prefixed 'document_path: '. If the upload fails, the claim still inserts, notes the fallback, and /claimed/ shows the email instructions as before. Document review stays manual in the back office; nothing approves client-side.

v44_checks.note: v4.4: claim-state awareness (listings, category cards, header, /for-business/, /business/) plus the How Featured works explainer. Data source: the public claimed_listings view (schema v5, approved claim slugs only) for badges and the manage bar; window.YTP_FEAT baked from yourtownpros-featured.json for Featured state lines. Fallback: every swap sits behind a positive answer; on the listing page the error guard precedes the first swap in source order and the promise chain ends in an empty catch (fallback_no_swap_on_error).

v45_checks.note: v4.5: owner toolkit. /business/ gains a Photos pane (storage-first upload to the private business-photos bucket, then a 'pending' photos row; owner submissions listed with In review / Approved / Not approved labels; copy states photos go live only after review) and a Requests pane (match_requests rows for the selected business's own slug only, newest first). The listing manage bar gains an Add photo button only when a runtime probe of the photos table answers without error; it is DOM-built after the probe, so no page carries it statically (v4.4's scan was revised to assert exactly that). Nothing renders a submitted photo publicly in this build; the approval-to-public pipeline is a later version. PARENT MUST APPLY schema v6 (yourtownpros-supabase-schema-v6.sql: photos table + force-pending trigger + throttle, business-photos bucket, match_requests owner select policy) before any of this works end to end; until then both panes fail soft.

v46_checks.note: v4.6: data refresh only. Source call list v28 (5,437 rows) replaces v25 (5,303): the 97 wave-33 email rows (45 Colorado Springs + 52 Fort Collins, never before in the directory) enter as listings, alongside the v26/v27 phone-only appends. No template, feature or design change; every standing invariant from v3.6 through v4.5 is re-asserted here over the new tree.

v47_checks.note: v4.7: Featured relevance engine. Partner cards (label: Sponsored · Featured partner) render only from the relevance config: score = vertical + audience + geography, threshold 60, V = 0 hard gate, scope gate, one card per page, holder first and never displaced. Static surfaces score at build time; owner surfaces (/business/, /for-business/, the /claimed/ confirmation) score at runtime from the same config baked in as window.YTP_REL. Data caveat: worked example (a)'s Loveland med-spas category page does not exist (zero Loveland med spas in the source data); its scoring reproduces exactly and the same-town placement is verified at the identical 70 on Loveland's buyer-vertical listing. The homepage takes no partner card: both profiles already hold holder cards in its Featured pros grid, and a partner card never duplicates a holder presence on the same page.

v48_checks.note: v4.8: photos go live. Approved owner photos render from the fetch tool's snapshot (hero replaces the stock band, gallery in render order, category card uses the first photo); approved review photos render inside their review from the baked YTP_REVIEW_PHOTOS map; the /business/ Photos pane lists submissions in public order with Move up / Move down controls writing sort_order only. PARENT MUST APPLY schema v7 (yourtownpros-supabase-schema-v7.sql: photos.sort_order / kind / review_id, the review-author insert policy, the owner update policy, widened guards) for ordering and review-photo submission to work end to end; until then the pane retries with the v6 select and the fetch tool reads with the v6 column set, and everything else in this build works. One v4.5 check (photo_rows_read_scoped) was revised for the new select, same documented pattern as before.

v49_checks.note: v4.9: review depth and community (Yelp gap audit rows 3 to 6) plus the mobile header hotfix. Listings gain a YourTownPros star histogram (fixture-tested math, labeled, never blended with the Google rating), sort and search over the loaded reviews, Helpful votes, and an Ask the Community section; /business/ shows pending questions. PARENT MUST APPLY schema v8 (yourtownpros-supabase-schema-v8.sql: review_votes, questions, answers with the v4 security pattern and an answers owner stamp) for votes and Q&A to work end to end; until then every v4.9 surface degrades softly. Mobile hotfix: at 1199px and below the homepage header returns to normal flow (position: static), the hero pull-up is cancelled and its content padding drops to spacing; desktop is byte identical, asserted below. Two documented check revisions: the v3.6 table whitelist gains the three v8 tables, and the v4.8 structural comparison normalizes both sides with the v4.9 deltas stripped (_norm49).
